summary: Enhance your skills with our Livelihoods and Climate Resilient Agriculture Training Course. Learn sustainable practices to thrive in changing climates.
lede: Climate-resilient agriculture links sustainable farming practices with livelihood planning to help address climate risks. This training is for agricultural and rural development professionals who assess vulnerability and plan practical resilience measures. It covers GIS and remote-sensing applications, soil and water management, integrated pest management, livelihood diversification, and setting indicators for adaptation roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and evaluation of agricultural and rural development initiatives.
modules: Climate Resilient Agriculture Foundations and Drivers
Soil Health and Water Resilience Strategies
Climate-Smart Value Chains and Market Access
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in agriculture, rural development, or environmental management. A basic understanding of climate change concepts and familiarity with project management cycles is required. No coding knowledge is necessary, though comfort with data analysis and digital tools is recommended.
